title: Rajamouli, Bhansali And Nag Ashwin Lead India's Most Awaited Director Line-Up
excerpt: Bollywood Hungama lists 11 blockbuster directors fans are waiting on. Cross-checking the list against current reporting, five have confirmed, dated projects — from Rajamouli's Varanasi to Bhansali's completed Love & War.
body:
• Bollywood Hungama's list of 11 blockbuster directors names S.S. Rajamouli, Prashanth Neel, Nag Ashwin, Sanjay Leela Bhansali, Aditya Dhar, Siddharth Anand, Atlee, Sukumar, Lokesh Kanagaraj, Sandeep Reddy Vanga and Ayan Mukerji.
  • Three of the next projects are dated: Rajamouli's Varanasi, with Mahesh Babu, Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Prithviraj Sukumaran, is set for April 7, 2027, and Bhansali's Love & War, with Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt and Vicky Kaushal, for January 21, 2027.
  • Nag Ashwin's Kalki 2898 AD Part 2 is targeting 2028, and Sandeep Reddy Vanga's Spirit, starring Prabhas, is now set for October 29, 2027.
  • For readers planning ahead: the two nearest confirmed releases on this list are Love & War in January 2027 and Varanasi in April 2027.

Bollywood Hungama has published a list of 11 directors whose previous blockbusters have left audiences waiting for their next films, spanning Hindi, Telugu and Tamil cinema. The list is a useful map of where theatrical expectations now sit, but it is not uniform: some directors have a dated, cast-confirmed next film, and others are listed only on the strength of their last release. The confirmed projects are the news.

The dated spectacles: Rajamouli and Bhansali

The Hungama list leads with S.S. Rajamouli, director of the Baahubali franchise and RRR, and names his next film as Varanasi, starring Mahesh Babu. Reporting by Pinkvilla puts the action-adventure's theatrical release on April 7, 2027, with Priyanka Chopra Jonas as Mandakini and Prithviraj Sukumaran as the antagonist Kumbha, opposite Mahesh Babu's archaeologist Rudhra. Rajamouli told Screen Daily, as reported by Pinkvilla, that the film is five to six times bigger than RRR and that he shot it in 275 days against RRR's 315, after doing more preparation on paper.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=6JHRdkGmQC4

Sanjay Leela Bhansali, listed for Devdas, Bajirao Mastani, Padmaavat and Gangubai Kathiawadi, is furthest along. Filmfare reported that Love & War, his romantic war drama with Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt and Vicky Kaushal, has wrapped filming and entered post-production ahead of a January 21, 2027 release, in Hindi, Tamil and Telugu. The film began shooting on November 7, 2024 and was first announced for Christmas 2025 before moving twice.

Sequels and star vehicles in production

Nag Ashwin, listed for Mahanati and Kalki 2898 AD, is making the sequel to the latter. Pinkvilla reported that Ashwin confirmed regular shooting for Kalki 2898 AD Part 2, with Prabhas, Amitabh Bachchan and Kamal Haasan, would begin in mid-October 2026, after individual scenes with Bachchan and Haasan were shot earlier in the year. Asked about the release year, Ashwin said, "Looks like 2028, certainly."

Two directors on the list are tied to Allu Arjun. Atlee, whose Hindi debut Jawan is his entry on the list, is shooting Raaka with Allu Arjun and Deepika Padukone in Mumbai, produced by Sun Pictures and targeting a release towards the end of 2027, according to Telugu Cinema. Lokesh Kanagaraj, listed for Kaithi, Vikram, Leo and Coolie, used a post on X on October 12 to assure fans that his film with Allu Arjun, known as AA23, is moving forward, Hollywood Reporter India reported. The film, announced on January 14, is produced by Mythri Movie Makers with music by Anirudh Ravichander, and will be Kanagaraj's first collaboration with the actor.

Sandeep Reddy Vanga, listed for Arjun Reddy, Kabir Singh and Animal, has Spirit, an action thriller starring Prabhas and Triptii Dimri. Hollywood Reporter India reported that the film has moved from March 5, 2027 to a worldwide release on October 29, 2027, a Diwali arrival that could put it in the same window as Ramayana: Part 2, though there has been no official word of a change from that film's makers.

The rest of the list, and what is not confirmed

Hungama also names Prashanth Neel of the KGF franchise and Salaar, Aditya Dhar of Uri: The Surgical Strike and the Dhurandhar duology, Siddharth Anand of War, Pathaan and Fighter, Sukumar of the Pushpa films, and Ayan Mukerji of Brahmastra: Part One – Shiva. For those five, the listicle does not name a specific dated next project, and this article does not assign them one. Their inclusion reflects the box-office weight of their last films and audience interest in an announcement, which is a different thing from a film in production.

What's next

The calendar that can be stated from confirmed reporting is: Love & War on January 21, 2027, Varanasi on April 7, 2027, Spirit on October 29, 2027, Raaka targeted for the end of 2027, and Kalki 2898 AD Part 2 in 2028. What the list shows is the shape of the next two years of Indian event cinema: large-scale, star-led films from a small group of directors, made across Hindi, Telugu and Tamil for a pan-Indian audience.
